highlights: UGREEN 20134 Micro HDMI to HDMI Adapter, Male to Female Cable HDMI 2.0 4K@60Hz HDR 3D Dolby 18Gbps High Speed Compatible with Raspberry Pi 5/Pi 4//Pi 500 GoPro Hero 7 6/Retroid Pocket 3+

Bidirectional Transmission: The Micro HDMI to HDMI adapter helps you stream audio and video from a camera, laptop, or tablet with a Micro HDMI port to your HDTV/projector/monitor with an HDMI port. It is also fit for connecting a laptop with an HDMI port to a portable monitor with a micro HDMI jack. Play games on a bigger TV screen or share high-definition video with your family and friends. Important Note: This is a Micro HDMI cord, not a Micro USB

Audio-visual Feast: This Micro HDMI to HDMI cable supports 3D technology, 4K@60Hz, Audio Return Channel(ARC), 1440P and 1080P Full HD Resolution, and Ethernet Channel. It delivers HD video and uncompressed multichannel digital audio into 1 cable for many home theater needs. You can get a micro HDMI to HDMI adapter to use with a capture card to use the camera as a webcam or streaming

Widely Compatible: This HDMI Micro adapter also known as HDMI Type D is compatible with Raspberry Pi 5/4/4b/Pi 400/Pi 500, GoPro Hero 7/6 /5/4/3/3+/2018, Retroid Pocket 3+/3/2+, Nikon b500, IdeaPad Miix 300 Tablet, ThinkPad 10/8, Yoga 2 Pro 3 ultrabook, Yoga 700 710, 710s, ASUS ZenBook UX305UA, portable monitor. Note: It is not compatible with Samsung phones or tablets with Micro USB

Anti-interference and Durable: Featuring the combination of gold-plated connectors, copper conductors, foil, and braid shielding, this high-speed HDMI to micro HDMI is durably built for minimal interference. Upgraded solid micro HDMI interface, tested by 10,000+ plug and play
Easy and Portable: This Micro HDMI cable is only 0.6ft(20cm) or 1.6ft (50cm), portable design, perfectly matched with your 4K HDMI cable, is not very tight and not loose, plug and play
